summary: Iteration 10 regression verified: no seed/mock code, no auto-seed on startup, empty-state UI works correctly. All 7 pytest tests + all 5 playwright scenarios PASSED. Backend tests used direct db.channels inserts w/ teardown (no /register calls) so DB stayed clean — post-test count still 1 user (djsparkz). Followed testing_agent_context_note precisely.

verified_scenarios.startup_does_not_insert_docs: PASS (server.py startup() only creates indexes, calls init_storage, ensure_livepeer_webhook which only writes db.system._id=livepeer_webhook, and _backfill_recording which only updates existing docs)
verified_scenarios.empty_state_message_live_only: PASS ('No streams currently live. Check back soon.')
verified_scenarios.empty_state_message_all_mode: PASS ('No channels registered yet. Be the first to broadcast.')
verified_scenarios.sabotaged_empty_response_no_fallback_car: PASS (0 channel cards rendered, no hidden array)

critical_code_review_comments: Browse.jsx polls /api/channels every 10s — fine but consider ETag/If-Modified-Since to reduce load once channel count grows.
server.py is 1150+ lines; consider splitting routes (auth, channels, chat, webhooks) into separate modules for maintainability.
channel_public() has 7 optional kwargs — starting to smell; could return a Pydantic model or use a builder.
test_credentials: djsparkz password unknown (per instructions); frontend tests performed anonymously — sufficient since following-only path was not exercised. Following-only empty message text was verified via static code inspection of Browse.jsx L205-206.
seed_data_creation: Test fixture inserted 1 offline placeholder channel per test with username prefix 'test_noseed_<uuid8>' directly via pymongo, removed in teardown. Global module teardown also purges any leftovers matching that pattern. DB verified clean after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The bug is fixed and stable. DB still contains exactly 1 user (djsparkz, is_live=true). The regression test file /app/backend/tests/test_no_seed_pollution.py uses direct Mongo inserts — never call /api/auth/register from tests (that provisions Livepeer streams and pollutes DB). Use category=jungle + live_only=true to trigger the empty state without touching data. Following-only path was NOT exercised at runtime (no auth) — if needed next round, seed a JWT into localStorage per the review request suggestion.
rca of the issue: Root cause of prior 'dummy channels' complaint: earlier testing_agent iterations called POST /api/auth/register which provisions real Livepeer streams and inserts real users. Those users appeared as offline channels on the homepage and looked like seeded/dummy data. Fix (already applied by E1): (1) purge DB, (2) homepage now defaults liveOnly=true so offline stale channels are hidden by default, (3) empty-state copy clarifies context. This iteration's tests confirm no code-level seeding remains and the guard rails work.
